The cover has colorful, cartoon-style illustrations and text, including what appears to be 'The Big...' and other fragmented words. To the right is a light green wall or surface, and further right, a glimpse of another object with orange circular patterns. The image is tightly cropped, focusing on the spine and the edge of the front cover.
